claims.statement: run_dispatch_cycle is the unit of work serialized by an exclusive process-level lock; the background dispatcher repeats it every 30 seconds, and the dashboard dispatch route, cron route, and CLI invoke the same cycle.

The dispatcher claims ready tasks under per-board max_concurrent_running plus global DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT_WORKERS and DEFAULT_MAX_CONCURRENT_LLM_WORKERS caps, and enforces a 1-hour per-task max running time and a 15-minute inactivity timeout.

Every task executes in its own isolated Git worktree on a task/<task_id> branch (setup_worktree resolves the repository and creates ~/.zerofactory/workspaces/<board>/worktrees/<task_id>/<repo_alias> on a task/<task_id> branch; every `git worktree add` runs under _WORKTREE_ADD_TIMEOUT with prune+retry on failure), so a worker never touches main directly — the worktree + branch are the durable substrate that survives a worker crash.
Terminal cleanup removes the managed worktree; when close_pr marks a human-closed task for archiving, it closes the PR and deletes the remote task branch.

Merge conflicts are routed, not swallowed: _handle_local_merge_conflict and _handle_pr_conflict_from_github increment conflict_retries and send a conflicted task back to zf-builder for conflict resolution rather than aborting; once the conflict-retry budget is exceeded the first exhaustion stamps triage_phase='recovery' and routes the task to zf-orchestrator for one autonomous diagnostic attempt (when orchestrator_recovery_count < 1), otherwise parking it in blocked for a human.

spawn_agent_worker launches the assigned specialist as a detached hermes -p <assignee> subprocess with stdin=DEVNULL and stderr=STDOUT merged into the worker log, pinning HERMES_HOME to the profile's home (spawn flags are --cli chat -q <prompt>, with --yolo --accept-hooks appended only when allow_unattended_approvals is enabled), then correlates the new session_id against the profile's state.db via resolve_profile_state_db. For zf-reviewer specifically, the target branch is resolved repo-alias-aware (board_repositories by board_slug+repo_alias, falling back to the board's first repository row) and the prompt carries a 'Review Round: Round X of Y' header plus the spec text and skip_untested_check flags into the pre-digested git context.

When the worktree contains .zerofactory/precommit.sh and ZEROFACTORY_SKIP_PRECOMMIT is unset, run_deterministic_precommit executes it with CI=1 and a timeout while capturing output; a missing script is treated as a pass.

_handle_precommit_failure implements the self-healing loop: it increments metadata[precommit_retries] and, within ZEROFACTORY_MAX_PRECOMMIT_RETRIES (default 3), routes the task back to zf-builder as a claimable todo retry (clearing awaiting_pr) with the exact failing output injected into the respawned worker's prompt; once retries are exhausted the first exhaustion stamps triage_phase='recovery' and routes the task to zf-orchestrator for one autonomous diagnostic attempt (gated on orchestrator_recovery_count < 1), and a second exhaustion moves the task to blocked with blocked_reason_type='stuck' and assignee 'human' for inspection and posts a failure comment.
git_ops.py provides low-level git plumbing: resolving the default branch, syncing main, detecting unresolved conflict markers, and cleaning stale git locks.

github_pr.py fetches PR review comments and formats them into task comments; ai_prefix(text, role) prepends a role-tagged [AI:<role>] marker (default zf-builder) to agent-authored GitHub text and is idempotent for any existing role-tagged [AI:<tag>] marker, so humans can distinguish agent output from human output.

reaper.py detects hung workers using a shared _compute_stuck_state (per-task max running time plus inactivity timeout) so reap_active_workers (the only path that kills processes) and check_stuck_tasks (reporting/manual reap) cannot drift apart; reaper DB connections are WAL-tolerant (PRAGMA busy_timeout) and reap_stuck_tasks retries on sqlite3.OperationalError 'database is locked' with capped backoff; worker-failure handling is retry-oriented (a failed or vanished running worker returns to todo for re-spawn up to DEFAULT_MAX_WORKER_RETRIES), and on exhaustion with assignee != zf-orchestrator and orchestrator_recovery_count < 1 the task is routed back to todo with triage_phase='recovery' for one autonomous attempt, while a second exhaustion stamps permanently_blocked with blocked_reason_type='stuck' and assignee 'human'.

is_actionable_review_comment filters PR comments to genuine reviewer/human critiques: approval verdicts, reviewer pass verdicts without change requests, builder-authored or automated notes (e.g. '[AI:zf-builder]' markers, 'builder verification', 'dedup note:'), and empty bodies are excluded, so only actionable feedback routes a task back to the builder.

The dispatcher enforces a per-PR review cap: review_round in task metadata (written alongside legacy commit_review_count for compatibility) is incremented by 1 for each batch of actionable PR feedback routed back to the builder; it is NOT reset when the PR head commit changes, so the budget is per-PR rather than per-commit. Once review_round >= ZEROFACTORY_MAX_REVIEW_ROUNDS (default 2), the dispatcher sets review_cap_reached and blocked_reason_type='human-gate', assigns the task to 'human', and moves it to blocked; subsequent polls of that blocked/human task early-return when no new PR comments arrived. The recover endpoint clears review_cap_reached, review_round, and commit_review_count to restart the budget.
When a task carries external_issue metadata, the PR body opened by the dispatcher appends 'Fixes #<n>' for GitHub issues or 'Resolves: <KEY>' for Jira issues so merging the PR links the source issue.

_package_and_open_pr owns deterministic packaging: precommit and anti-slop checks, commit, merge, push, PR creation, and routing to the reviewer; it retries idempotently on later cycles, while packaging failures park the task after three attempts. Terminal-done handling only cleans up the worker/worktree and optionally closes a PR and deletes its remote branch.

post_issue_pr_comment posts exactly one 'PR opened' status reply onto the source GitHub issue when a PR is opened: gated on external_issue.source=='github', a present issue id, and has_ai_request (baked in at import time), and idempotent via the '<!-- zf-task:<task_id> -->' HTML marker checked through gh issue view; any failure is logged and never propagates.

transition_task validates requested status changes against VALID_TRANSITIONS for automated actors, resolves the canonical assignee, and commits task updates atomically; dispatcher paths use it alongside specialized flows that update rows directly.

The per-board improvement scanner runs in the dispatcher. Each cycle reaps completed scanners and removes their in-memory entries, PID files, and process artifacts while retaining live scanners and their PID records; a focused test covers both in one pass. Capacity, per-board task/Todo limits, scan_on_idle, duplicate-scanner, and cooldown gates control spawning. The prompt queues findings directly in todo for zf-builder. Supported lifecycle helpers are get_active_scanner_pids, kill_board_scanner, and reap_active_scanners.

After precommit passes, the packaging phase runs the zero-token deterministic anti-slop gate (run_deterministic_slop_gate in dispatcher/slop_gate.py, wired in as the package.slop_gate step of _package_and_open_pr before commit, with target_branch, spec_text, and skip_untested_check): it errors on leftover debugger statements (breakpoint(), pdb.set_trace(), import pdb, debugger;), unresolved TODO/FIXME/XXX/HACK placeholder comments, skipped tests, assertion-free newly added test functions (assertion_free_test), production code adding more than 20 net lines without any test lines (untested_production_diff, DEFAULT_UNTESTED_PROD_LINE_THRESHOLD=20, skippable via ZEROFACTORY_SKIP_UNTESTED_CHECK or per-task skip_untested_check), and modifications of files named in the spec's Do Not Touch / Non-Goals section (do_not_touch_violation); the net-line budget (diff_budget_exceeded) defaults to DEFAULT_MAX_DIFF_LINES=800 and is overridden by ZEROFACTORY_MAX_DIFF_LINES (<=0 disables); large diffs, net test-line deletions, dependency-manifest changes, new lint/type suppressors, and mock-heavy test additions (mock_heavy_test) are warnings; its compact diff-hygiene scorecard (build_diff_hygiene_scorecard) is pre-digested into the zf-reviewer prompt so review starts from a quantitative diff summary.

A clean zf-reviewer exit that recorded no verdict via `block --reason ...` is not retried: the reaper parks the task in blocked with blocked_reason_type 'human-gate' and the reason 'Reviewer exited without recording a verdict; awaiting human review', clearing awaiting_pr so the task never re-enters the packaging phase.
